reviews.title: Surface Mount
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 13, 2019
reviews.text: I purchased these light for a 1999 jayco 12 UDK Pop Up Camper. The ones on there previously are discontinued, they wrapped around the rear end. I am very happy with these tho they are very bright and offer a great replacement. Size ( L x W x D ) are great too. On the driver side a license plate holder is included which will need to be mounted separately but the tail light itself provides a white light at the bottom which illuminates the plates, also a good way to identify which light goes where ( tip) check the bottom white square at the bottom of light means driver side. Mounting lights... These lights come with bolts NOT SCREWS in my case wanting to mount them to the back of the trailer not the bumper I couldn't use the bolts. Work around... 4 small screws hold the red plastic case to black frame I removed those screws and removed the red plastic ( a small red square on the side will come off to take note of how it comes off to make sure you replace it the same way ) with that removed you will see the lights and a clear plastic holding lights there are 4 small screws holding that to black frame carefully remove. Now you are able to screw black frame to your location of choice. I placed the screws close to the small screws holding the clear plastic ( CHECK TO ENSURE LIGHT ARE FUNCTIONING ) then carefully pushed the wires back in replaced the clear plastic with lights, replaced the small red square that came off taking note how it came off ( one side should have a small tab ) replace the rest of the red plastic cover and stand back and give yourself a pat on the back. HAPPY TRAVEL'S

reviews.title: Disabled, Love My Case, BUT Muffled Sound Using Speaker with Deep Voices
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 8, 2019
reviews.text: I am permanently disabled, which means my cell phone is very important to me. Before buying a phone case, I compared cases on two different review sites to make sure I was selecting a case that included pretty specific features, such as, (1) durability (Geez, it better be because an iPhone 11 Pro isn't cheap); (2) easy button access / control (fine motor issues; painful); (3) the iPhone 11 Pro's speaker quality maintained (hearing loss and holding the phone is painful); and (4) minimal added weight (again holding the phone as well as carrying it in my purse cause pain). So far so good on 1, 2, and 4. Item number 3 depends on the person. Ironically, the voices I typically have the most trouble understanding (high pitched, petite females) sound great using the Defense Shield's tuner system. The manufacturer advertises that their system improves/helps the speaker's sound quality. The reviewers mentioned this too. However, voices similar to my son's that are deep sounded muffled as if he had a cold, which he did not. I've nagged him enough that he knows to speak into the phone and not use his speaker when talking to me. Once, I took him off the speaker phone, I could understand him clearly. The problem was my holding the iPhone in the typical position immediately shortened our call due to the intense pain reverberating through my hand and fingers. In my opinion, the Defense Shield Series does have a significant limitation as it relates to low pitch voices, especially since this a highlighted feature for the case. However, this design flaw also likely affects a relatively small population of customers in any meaningful way. I would recommend this case with the caveat that the buyer understand all of the pros and cons. More importantly, comparing my Defense Shield to the other phone cases I reviewed, I am glad I bought this phone case. Tracy

reviews.title: Quality of life saver
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 7, 2022
reviews.text: This product is the best purchase I’ve made in a long time. I feel as though I should give some backstory. We have two dogs, Oma (Sheltie) in the photos and a chiweenie (King). Oma went on walks nearly every day of her life, including cold WI winter nights, up until this April. She is 10 years old and has osteoarthritis. For a few years we were able to just treat flare ups with her prescriptions and a couple weeks rest, then she could go back to going for daily walks and playing ball. However this April she started forming a cyst between her front left pinky and ring toes. It can’t be surgically removed due to not enough skin available to close the wound. We would try to take her for a walk and she would sit after about 50 feet. Then I’d pick her up and carry her home. We tried a gorilla cart wagon and that worked ok but it was cumbersome and not that safe. Also there had to always be two of us humans to make it work. I could tell Oma was getting depressed because she could no longer do the things she loved and so was our other dog because he couldn’t go on walks much either because we didn’t want to make Oma jealous. We humans were also depressed because no matter what we tried (bandaging, multiple vet visits, braces, chiropractic, CBD, supplements, omega 3, homemade dog food, massages, paw creams, etc) her paw wasn’t healing and she was depressed. Fast forward to a week ago when the stroller arrived. I put it together in about 20 minutes and we went on our first walk. We had both dogs on leashes and had Oma walk as far as she could until she sat down to tell us she couldn’t walk any further then we put her in the stroller. She seemed to really enjoy it. The next day, same thing. The third day, we were heading to the sidewalk to start our walk and Oma sat in the grass, in our yard, signaling to us that she wanted to be in the stroller from the start! We are back to our family routine of walking everyday. Oma is content in her stroller, King is happy that he’s going on walks again with his sister and us humans are happier because the quality of life of our dogs finally improved again after months of hurdles. I wish I was able to have bought this sooner. I had to save up because it’s pricey but saving for it was worth it. You won’t regret it.

reviews.title: Amazing stroller!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 6, 2019
reviews.text: Okay so first of all, the instructions are hidden INSIDE the stroller. I thought this was pretty annoying tbh bc I didnt know how to open the stroller or put the wheels on. And I kinda just used common sense and then once I had the wheels on and the stroller open, I found the instructions. Before I purchased the stroller, I read a lot of reviews. To the reviewer who stated that it collapsed with their dogs inside, there is a red swing-bar latch on the side that is supposed to be latched upon opening to prevent the unexpected collapse of the stroller. The stroller is great quality! I am 23 years old and both of my parents were shocked by how great the quality of this stroller was, claiming that when I was a baby, they bought me one of the best strollers on the market at the time, which was much less quality than this pet stroller lol. The only 2 complaints I have is that the leather on the handlebar feels a bit cheap (I'm not expecting real leather but still, it feels very plastic-y). The handlebar is padded though and it feels great, very comfortable and easy to grip. And the second complaint I have is the latch that keeps the stroller closed when in the folded position, it is just a flimsy plastic piece with a hook that swivels to hook onto a bar. I wish this latch was more sturdy, like a metal piece or something. The mesh enclosure is great! It is exactly what I was expecting! It's a medium thickness, not too thin and not too thick. My dogs scratched at it for a bit when they got excited when I called their names and it didnt rip! I thought for sure it would at least tear a bit but it didnt. I also LOVE the no-zip feature of the mesh too! I read reviews of other strollers before purchasing this one and one of the complaints were that the zippered strollers were hard to zip and they broke easily. This one is the mesh with a sturdy bar at the bottom to keep the shape and in the 2 corners are clips that clip onto the bottom half (the "bin" where the pets sit). Make sure to pull the bottom sturdy bar of the the mesh down & around the top sturdy bar of the bin where the pets sit and then clip the clips or it might make a small "hole" area where the two parts meet, and allow the pet to stick its nose out. As long as you pull the top part over the bottom, you'll be good. It also has 2 leash clips inside the stroller which allowed me to have both my dogs inside. One of my dogs is a malteese mix who is about 15 lbs and my other dog is a shih tzu mix who is about 8 lbs. With the back portion of the stroller extended, they both fit very well inside together with enough room to move around a bit and also sit and lay comfortably. The bottom storage area of the stroller is a great addition as well, however it is a bit hard to reach when the the pet area is extended all the way back. I kind of had to squat and reach under blindly lol. But that's just me being nit-picky, it's not a big deal. It also held a lot. I read one review that said it ripped quickly. I'm not sure what they put in it but I had a spray can of sunscreen, 2 wet dog food plastic resealable bowls, a bottle of water, the dogs' bottle of water/bowl combo, 2 dog toys and their retractable leash and everything fit very well with much more room available if needed. The stroller is pretty easy to maneuver, a bit heavy but I mean that's expected bc I have two dogs inside plus their food, water, toys & sunscreen and 2 bottles of water. It was a bit difficult when going up a curb bc I'm short (5'4) and the stroller is pretty big and I cant see when exactly I need to tilt the stroller up. It's not a big deal at all, its not even the stroller's fault, just something to consider. It rolls well on cement, wood planks (the peir at the beach), and even on grass. I have not tried it on any other surfaces so I'm not sure how it will move on sand and such. Overall, I am beyond pleased with this stroller. I love the rose gold bars so much with the black body and the tan handlebar. It's great quality and you wont be disappointed! *also, I had read the reviews that said that the plastic on the stroller comes bolted into the stroller, leaving little pieces of plastic around the bolts. This is true, however I wasnt very annoyed by it bc I was prepared after reading the reviews. Just be conscious when taking it off and dont use scissors or tweezers bc it will scratch the metal.

reviews.title: Excellent ac adapter at a low price
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States 🇺🇸 on April 26, 2018
reviews.text: This is an excellent product at a low price. I checked other ac adapters and they were a lot more expensive, even the unknown brands. Initially, I was having trouble getting it to work, but later found out that it works perfectly if you let Windows 10 install the drivers through Windows Update; the drivers that come with the included CD are outdated and don’t work. Just plug it into the usb port and let windows install the drivers. After I got it working I found that this adapter is consistent and fast and I always get my top internet speed of 70Mb/s. If you use an N adapter you only get speeds up to 30Mb/s so I highly recommend this ac adapter. If you have a higher internet speed, this adapter will probably be able to reach that as well. Note that this adapter’s speed is also faster than if you are directly connected to your router via an ethernet cable; my top speed via the cable was 30Mb/s. The adapter is also well built and it doesn’t look like it will break. This is one of the best purchases I’ve made on Amazon.

Enter the "Mindful and Modern Folding Meditation Bench". I read about the benefits of using meditation benches or seats and finally convinced myself to buy this one based upon the great reviews and I'm glad I did. I love that it is made out of bamboo which makes it light and strong with a nice grain to it. Folding legs and carry case make it easy to transport. The hinges for the foldable legs are quality and durable. Because the hinges are stronger and thicker the don't sit completely flush against the bamboo boards but they're solidly attached and I don't foresee any problems with these going forward. The angle of the seat is perfect and distributes the weight from the buttocks down to the knees reducing pressure on one's backside but also pushing back and upwards from the ground. Not having the weight of my upper body directly on my calves and feet means no more pins-and-needles when I've finished meditation. Something else to think about is when I was a teenager practicing karate and asked my instructor about sitting in seiza for longs periods he said that the lack of blood flow through the legs can cause the blood to clot. Even though the clotting gets resolved after leaving the position it's probably a good idea to avoid it in the first place with a bench. That was another reason I considered buying one. I found I sit quite a bit higher as a result of the bench and at first it felt weird but I soon got used to it and realised it was great for the posture too. I can now have prolonged periods of sitting in seiza without the side effects. Highly recommend this bench.

reviews.title: Successfully controls my Mitsubishi Electric Mini-Split system
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States 🇺🇸 on November 5, 2020
reviews.text: I wasn't sure if this device would support my AC, but I'm happy to report that it does. Using this, I was able to automatically turn-up the fan in the bedroom at night and turn it off in the morning on a schedule. However, the device is only able to replicate commands; it isn't able to understand the state of the system it is controlling (e.g. for something to be really smart, it takes also a temperature sensor or other sensors along with this controller). This does what I wanted, and so gets a positive rating from me. However, there are a few areas of polish/quality that lead me to give it 4 stars rather than 5. To earn 5 stars, I would want to see the following fixed: 1.) Lack of a charger: on the positive, this uses standard USB. On the negative, though, they really ought to throw in the base charger and not have you contribute one of your own charger bases. The fact that a base charger is not included can make the cost of the device misleading. 2.) Stated setup requirement of 2.4Ghz Wi-Fi only: I did not, in fact, need to turn off the 5Ghz network for setup to work (which is fortunate given that my Wi-Fi does not support toggling the 5 Ghz network off), but the app instructs its users to go through the additional headache of disabling the 5Ghz network (even though it is apparently not necessary). 3.) Smart Life app translation quality: the app used to control the system has an English user interface, but the fact that it was not originally in English is obvious due to some translation quality issues. The authors of that app should upgrade the translations with a review that looks at the text in the context in which it will appear.

Furthermore--there is no feature to safe favorites, so when you want to visit one of your favorites, you have to tell Alexa and it's a hit and a miss. Nevertheless--I have experimented with other remotes and this one is as good as any of the rest. UPDATE: I received a defective remote and Amazon sent me a replacement. I received the replacement yesterday and found set up and connecting to alexa fairly easy, in spite of lack of directions. So far--remote seems to be working well. I raised my overall rating from three to four stars. Thee reason for my four star rating is the support team was excellent and the limited directions. reviews.title: Great for what I needed!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States 🇺🇸 on October 29, 2021
reviews.text: These boxes are so great!! I've been looking for something like this for so long, and these fit my needs perfectly! They work great to store my miniature model horse collection. Pros: -Aesthetics. They look so nice! I added metal label holders to the front of mine, and I like how professional it looks. One downside: I ordered several sets of boxes a few months apart and, as you can see in the photo, the color varied slightly between my orders. One set is a darker, more yellow shade, and the other is a lighter, more red(?) shade. -Simple. They're SUPER easy to assemble! Nothing could be easier. -Good size. I plan to get a 13in cube shelf to store these, and in the meantime they fit great under the bed or in the closet. Cons: -Sturdiness. If you need to store heavier items, these boxes might not hold up well. Since mine are packed with small models, fleece, and foam, the structural integrity works perfect for me because everything inside each box is lightweight. I also used "Plastic DIY Grid Drawer Dividers" inside, which helps keep the box walls from being crushed inward. -Not very stackable. I DON'T recommend stacking them more than 2 or 3 high because the lids will buckle easily. (I stacked mine temporarily for the photograph to show the color variations). -Magnet closures. I've seen a few people comment on this, but it actually hasn't been a big problem for me once I figured out that the lid closes fine IF there is nothing pressing out from the interior sides of the box. The walls of the box are flexible, so if anything inside the box pushes against them, the walls bulge out and it prevents the magnets from staying secure. All in all, I LOVE these boxes! The look great, they are exactly what I was looking for, and I would definitely but them again! I wouldn't mind if they were a bit sturdier and more stackable, but I'll take what I can get for now!
